## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **2026-04-17**  
  Link: https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-design-anthropic-labs  
  Anthropic launched `Claude Design`, a research-preview tool built on Claude Opus 4.7 for generating prototypes, slide decks, one-pagers, and other visual assets from prompts.  
  **Why it matters:** This is a product-surface expansion from model access into higher-level creative tooling, positioning Anthropic more directly against AI-native design and productivity workflows.

- **2026-04-16**  
  Link: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-rosalind  
  OpenAI introduced `GPT-Rosalind`, a life-sciences-focused reasoning model aimed at drug discovery, genomics, protein reasoning, and scientific research workflows.  
  **Why it matters:** This is a targeted vertical-model play, signaling continued movement from general-purpose assistants toward domain-specific frontier systems.

- **2026-04-16**  
  Link: https://openai.com/index/accelerating-cyber-defense-ecosystem  
  OpenAI launched a cyber-defense initiative combining `GPT-5.4-Cyber`, Trusted Access for Cyber, and $10 million in API grants for security firms and enterprises.  
  **Why it matters:** It pushes frontier AI deeper into security operations, with institutional partnerships and funding that increase the odds of real operational deployment.

- **2026-04-16**  
  Link: https://openai.com/index/codex-for-almost-everything  
  OpenAI upgraded Codex on macOS and Windows with computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins.  
  **Why it matters:** This materially broadens Codex from coding assistant to desktop agent platform, increasing competitive pressure in agentic developer tooling.

## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

- **2026-04-17**  
  Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aw_k00T4UFk  
  Workflow: pair a high-level autonomous IDE agent (`anti-gravity`) with `Claude Code` for precise terminal-side implementation and refactors.  
  Tools/models: anti-gravity agent in planning mode; Claude Code; Claude Opus 4.6/Sonnet-class models as described in the video.  
  Setup:
  1. Install anti-gravity and Claude Code.
  2. Use anti-gravity first for repo exploration, planning, and broad task decomposition.
  3. Hand concrete implementation tasks to Claude Code in the terminal or extension.
  4. Bounce back to anti-gravity when context gets large or orchestration across files/tools is needed.
  5. Run multiple agent instances in parallel for separate subtasks where needed.
  Available now: Yes, per the video’s walkthrough.  
  **Why it matters:** The actionable tactic is model/tool separation by role: orchestration in one surface, precise edits/execution in another. That is reproducible today for teams already using agentic coding tools.
